title: Spooky plants and the World Championship begins.

themes.title: Patch theme
themes.description: Spooky plants and the World Championship begins.

themes.title: Champion balance
themes.description: 6 champion buffs, 3 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: Spooky plants and the World Championship begins. Structured changes across 18 entities this patch.

champions.name: Anivia
champions.tldr: Cooldown reduced to 11–7 seconds from 12–8.; Base damage increased to 55–155 from 50–150.
champions.gameplayImpact: Anivia is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Empowered base damage
lines.note: Empowered base damage increased to 110–310 from 100–300.

champions.name: Azir
champions.tldr: Recharge timer increased to 12–6 seconds from 10–6.; AP ratio changed to 30–70% AP from 40–60% AP.
champions.gameplayImpact: Azir is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Recharge timer
lines.note: Recharge timer increased to 12–6 seconds from 10–6.

lines.label: AP ratio
lines.note: AP ratio changed to 30–70% AP from 40–60% AP.

lines.label: Soldier subsequent target damage modifier
lines.note: Soldier subsequent target damage modifier changed to 20–100% from 25–100% (lv 1–16).

lines.label: Damage AP ratio
lines.note: Damage AP ratio increased to 60% AP from 40% AP.

champions.name: Briar
champions.tldr: Maximum number of stacks reduced to 5 from 7.
champions.gameplayImpact: Briar loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

lines.label: Maximum number of stacks
lines.note: Maximum number of stacks reduced to 5 from 7.

champions.name: Camille
champions.tldr: Armor growth reduced to 4.5 from 5.; Base damage increased to 60–160 from 50–150.
champions.gameplayImpact: Camille was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

champions.name: Fizz
champions.tldr: Passive base damage over time per tick increased to 30/6 to 90/6 from 20/6 to 60/6.; Total base damage increased to 30–90 from 20–60.
champions.gameplayImpact: Fizz was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.
